name: MOT_QM_QUOTA_PLANS_B
description: Stores the quota plans. Alos stores related information such as Status, Date of activation and whether it should be available to final users.

columns.name: QUOTA_PLAN_ID
columns.description: Primary Key

columns.name: COPY_PREDICTION_FLAG
columns.description: Whether predicted quota must be copied to territory quota.

columns.name: COPY_QUOTA_PLAN_ID
columns.description: Quota plan Id for copying Quota Plan options, Territory Quota and Resource Quota from past Quota Plan

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CALENDAR_ID
columns.description: FK : GL_CALENDARS

columns.name: PERIOD_YEAR
columns.description: Period year from GL_PERIODS

columns.name: PLAN_START_DATE
columns.description: Quota plans start date

columns.name: PLAN_END_DATE
columns.description: Quota Plans end date

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of the quota plan - In Plan, Active, Complete

columns.name: ACTIVATION_DATE
columns.description: Date of activation

columns.name: DEFAULT_PREDICTION_FLAG
columns.description: Whether predicted quota should be calculated

columns.name: TRACK_QUOTA_PLAN_FLAG
columns.description: Whether sales managers should be able to use this quota plan to assign quotas

columns.name: PAD_THRESHOLD_PERCENT
columns.description: The threshold percent for the quota plan

columns.name: SEASONALITY_FACTOR_DEFN_ID
columns.description: FK : MOT_QM_SEASON_FACTOR_DEFN_B

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_SYNC_TIME
columns.description: Indicates the last time Quota plan was successfully synchronized

columns.name: SYNC_STATUS
columns.description: Indicates the Syncronization Status

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
